manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a ball tossed vertically to a second ball released from rest at the top of the toss.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes display a tossed ball and a dropped ball. At the apex, the tossed ball momentarily stops while gravity continuously pulls downward, matching the exact motion of a ball dropped from rest.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
